newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says did not make G7 comments to bank.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says did not make G7 comments to bank.

text.p: Senior Japanese Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Friday that he did not make comments which were attributed to him by banking sources.
"I did not make these comments to anyone," Sakakibara told Reuters.
Earlier, banking sources quoted Sakakibara as telling them that the Group of Seven industrialised nations (G7) is likely to call for stable currencies at their meeting in Berlin on February 8.

The sources also said Sakakibara, director-general of the Ministry of Finance's International Finance Bureau, told a major bank that Japanese monetary authorities are ready to intervene if the dollar rises relentlessly before next the G7 meeting.
